author: hungry happens
transcript: Ready to take your chicken dinner to the next level? Let me show you how to make my killer crack chicken recipe. Whisk together some olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, Worcestershire, honey, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, and season with your soul. The longer you marinate, the better it'll taste. Then bake at 450 for 35 minutes and love your life.
title: Killer Crack Chicken Marinade Recipe
one_liner: A bold, flavor-packed chicken marinade baked at high heat for an easy weeknight dinner.
key_points: Marinade combines olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, Worcestershire, honey, lemon juice, garlic, and ginger

instructions: 1. Whisk together olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, Worcestershire, honey, lemon juice, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
2. Add chicken and marinate — the longer, the better.
